text.name: Roaring Moon

attacks.name: Vengeance Fletching
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Ancient card in your discard pile.

text.flavor: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

text.name: Flutter Mane

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Midnight Fluttering
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon has no Abilities, except for Midnight Fluttering.

attacks.name: Hex Hurl
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

text.name: Great Tusk

attacks.name: Land Collapse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If you played an Ancient Supporter card from your hand during this turn, discard 3 more cards in this way.

text.flavor: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Flip the Script
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Flip the Script Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Cruel Arrow
attacks.text: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Radiant Greninja

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Concealed Cards
abilities.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Moonlight Shuriken
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Radiant Pokémon Rule
rules.text: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

text.flavor: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

text.name: Explorer's Guidance
effect: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Professor Sada's Vitality
effect: Choose up to 2 of your Ancient Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you attached any Energy in this way, draw 3 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Boss's Orders
effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: PokéStop
effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard 3 cards from the top of their deck. If a player discarded any Item cards in this way, they put those Item cards into their hand.

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Earthen Vessel
effect: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Pokégear 3.0
effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

effect: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.

(If you don't reveal a Basic Pokémon, put this card in the discard pile.) Then, shuffle your face-down Prize cards.

effect: You can use this card only if you discard 3 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for an Item card, a Pokémon Tool card, a Supporter card, and a Stadium card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

effect: The Ancient Pokémon this card is attached to gets +60 HP, recovers from all Special Conditions, and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

effect: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, the attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
